description: ipTM value for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average pLDDT score of all residues of chain A of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average pLDDT score of all residues of chain B of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.

Number of positive-contact residue pairs between the two domains in the single structure prediction, i.e. residue-residue pairs with a non-clash atom contact (dist < 5 A) that pass the confidence filters (both residues pLDDT above threshold and both-direction PAE < 15 A).
Percentage of all residues with pLDDT values < 50 in the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Maximum single pLDDT score of all residues of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average pLDDT score of all residues of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Minimum single pLDDT score of all residues of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average pLDDT score of all interfacial residues of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average of the absolute differences between the pLDDT scores within each pair of residues within a contact across the interface of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Maximum pLDDT score of all interfacial residues of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Minimum pLDDT score associated with the contacts in the interface of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.

Average contact score for all residue pairs in the interface of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair. The contact score is calculated as the number of atom contacts (dist < 5 A) between a pair of residues multiplied by their averaged pLDDT and divided by (1 + the average of the PAEs (x, y) and (y, x)).

Maximum contact score for all residue pairs in the interface of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair. The contact score is calculated as the number of atom contacts (dist < 5 A) between a pair of residues multiplied by their averaged pLDDT and divided by (1 + the average of the PAEs (x, y) and (y, x)).

Median contact score for all residue pairs in the interface of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair. The contact score is calculated as the number of atom contacts (dist < 5 A) between a pair of residues multiplied by their averaged pLDDT and divided by (1 + the average of the PAEs (x, y) and (y, x)).
Total number of residues involved in contacts in the interface of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Percentage of all residues that are involved in interfacial contacts in the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Total number of unique inter-residue contact pairs identified in the interface of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Percentage of all inter-atom contacts classified as involving peptide backbone atoms in the single structure prediction.
Average PAE of all residues of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average PAE value associated with residue pairs across interfaces with atoms closer than 5A for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average PAE score for all interfacial residue pairs of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average of the differences in pAE(x,y vs y,x) for all interfacial residue pairs of the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Maximum PAE score of all interfacial residue pairs for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Minimum PAE score of all interfacial residue pairs for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Percentage of all inter-atom contacts classified as repulsive (distance <= 5A) between two atoms of the same charge for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
pTM value for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Average fraction of the full-length parent protein sequence covered by each of the two domains in the domain pair, i.e. mean of (domain length / full-length protein length) over the two domains.
Percentage of all inter-atom contacts classified as hydrogen bonds (distance < 3A) in the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Percentage of all inter-atom contacts classified as salt bridges (distance <= 5A) between two atoms of opposite charge for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Percentage of all inter-atom contacts that were not classified as hydrogen bonds, salt bridges, or repulsive in the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
Number of total atom contacts in an interface divided by the number of unique interfacial residues identified in the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
pDockQ score calculated by the Elofsson lab method for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
pDockQ v2 score calculated by the Elofsson lab method for the single structure prediction for a given domain pair.
ipSAE interface confidence score computed from the PAE matrix with per-residue d0 scaling (d0 derived from the per-residue interface contact count); A->B direction, maximum over interface residues.
ipSAE interface confidence score computed from the PAE matrix with d0chn scaling (d0 derived from the total number of residues of both chains); A->B direction, maximum over interface residues.
ipSAE interface confidence score computed from the PAE matrix with d0dom scaling (d0 derived from the number of unique interface residues); A->B direction, maximum over interface residues.
Maximum of the A->B and B->A asymmetric ipsae_d0res values.
Maximum of the A->B and B->A asymmetric ipsae_d0chn values.
Maximum of the A->B and B->A asymmetric ipsae_d0dom values.
ipTM-like PAE-based confidence score computed over all residue pairs of the two chains with d0chn scaling; A->B direction, maximum over residues.
Maximum of the A->B and B->A asymmetric iptm_d0chn values.
LIS (Local Interface Score): mean of (12 - PAE) / 12 over all cross-chain residue pairs with PAE < 12 A, averaged over both the A->B and B->A directions; confidence score for the predicted interface.
Maximum of the A->B and B->A asymmetric n0res values.
Total number of unique interface residues (on both chains) with PAE below the 10 A cutoff in the single structure prediction.
d0 scale derived from the total number of residues of both chains.
Total number of residues of both chains in the domain pair.
Number of interface residues on chain A (chain-A residues participating in at least one inter-chain contact).
Number of interface residues on chain B (chain-B residues participating in at least one inter-chain contact).
